'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Angelo Consoli DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif|label=A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage}}
* '''Username:''' GravityShadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
